description: CardinalLizard is a cyber threat actor linked to China, primarily active since 2018, targeting entities in Asia. Known for sophisticated attacks involving spear-phishing and custom malware with anti-detection features, CardinalLizard poses a significant threat to organizations in their targeted sectors.
